verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of an ops user adding custom fields or building filtered, sorted, and shared list views without an admin. The only related item is a community comment that Salesforce is strong at customization in general (salesforce-comm-6), which does not address non-admin self-service fields or views. Other items cover adjacent features such as sales flows, forecasting, CLI commands, and admin access policies, which do not transfer to this story.
